1.2. Appoint qualified persons to conduct the internship.
1.3. Create the necessary conditions for students to complete the internship programme and to prevent
them from being employed in posts and jobs, which is not in line with the internship programme and
their future specialization.
1.4. Enable students to learn new techniques and advanced technology.
1.5. Ensure safe working conditions for students at every workplace. Conduct mandatory occupational
safety training. Train students in safe working practices, if necessary. Provide students of protective
clothing, safety devices and preventive treatment in accordance with the standards established for
regular employees.
1.6. Provide students and their assigned supervisors from the university with the opportunity to
use laboratories, offices, workshops, a library, technical and other documentation necessary to
complete the internship program.
1.7. After completing the internship, provide a characteristic for each student-trainee, which should
reflect the implementation of the internship program, the quality of the report prepared by the student,
and more..
1.8. Provide students with the opportunity to collect information for term papers and theses based on
the results of the enterprise's activities and is not a commercial secret, based on the directions of the
departments.
